svg.title: A gray, chained dungeon door representing an unfinished mission next to the same door glowing and open once the mission is complete
svg.desc: Two gothic stone archway doors side by side. The left door is closed, gray, and bound with chains and a padlock, symbolizing an incomplete mission. The right door is open, its wooden leaves swung against the frame, revealing a glowing gold and purple passage with a lit rune above, symbolizing a completed mission.
